generation_table.deterministic_rule: Hash the public seed and bind it to the exact generator identity, version, and algorithm.
Resolve the one digest-bound closed scale manifest before allocating identities.
Allocate stable lineage ranges in ascending counter order without materializing note bodies.
Assign every complete lineage group to exactly one immutable partition and then one partition-local shard.
Account every fixed scale dimension exactly once and reject every gap or duplicate.
Canonicalize the compact manifest and seal its digest after all invariants pass.

redistribution_table.condition: The request binds the current sealed manifest digest.
redistribution_table.recovery: Evaluate the current-manifest request through normal redistribution processing.

redistribution_table.condition: A whole lineage group moves between shards inside its existing partition.
redistribution_table.recovery: Recompute shard summaries and retain partition membership digests.

redistribution_table.condition: An identical redistribution request already has a sealed receipt.
redistribution_table.recovery: Return the digest-identical sealed receipt without another effect.

redistribution_table.condition: A request moves any lineage group between train, calibration, or test.
redistribution_table.recovery: Reject and preserve the sealed manifest.

redistribution_table.condition: A request moves only part of a lineage group.
redistribution_table.recovery: Reject and preserve the sealed manifest.

redistribution_table.condition: Redistribution changes a fixed scale or coverage total.
redistribution_table.recovery: Reject and preserve the sealed manifest.

redistribution_table.condition: The request binds a stale manifest or generator binding.
redistribution_table.recovery: Regenerate a plan from the current sealed manifest.

redistribution_table.condition: The post-state changes an immutable partition membership digest.
redistribution_table.recovery: Reject and preserve the sealed manifest.
